TARGET:
Eine Szene innerhalb eines Körpers. hellrosa Gewebe zeigt sich im Hintergrund, wobei gelbliche Fettpolster an der Gewebewand im Hintergrund zu sehen sind, die von einer Membran gehalten werden. Von der Mitte nach links ist eine weitere Struktur zu sehen, die von einer Membran umschlossen ist. ein schwarzes längliches Instrument mit einem Haken am Ende ist zu sehen, der von unten nach oben durch die Membran der länglichen Gewebestrukur fährt und diese dabei auftrennt. Etwas Rauch weht durchs Bild. Rechts ist schwarz verbranntes Gewebe zu sehen. Nach dem Schnitt ist das Gewebe leicht gelblich. Unten ist eine Öffnung mit Fettgewebe.

A close-up laparoscopic view shows a black surgical instrument with 'KARL STORZ' printed on it positioned over reddish, vascularized tissue. The background consists of pinkish-red tissue with visible blood vessels. There is no clear evidence of yellowish fat pads, a distinct membrane-enclosed structure, smoke, or blackened burned tissue.

A laparoscopic view shows a large, smooth, pinkish tissue mass in the background. A black, elongated surgical instrument with the text 'KARL STORZ' is positioned diagonally across the frame. Below the instrument, there are yellowish, fatty tissue structures and a whitish, membrane-like layer. The lighting is bright, typical of endoscopic surgery.

A close-up laparoscopic view shows a grey surgical instrument labeled 'KARL STORZ' positioned over pinkish-red internal tissue. In the lower left, there is a rounded structure with a yellowish, fatty appearance. The background consists of dark red tissue walls.

A laparoscopic view showing a surgical field with yellowish fatty tissue in the background and a pinkish tissue wall. A long, black instrument with a hook at the end is positioned vertically, appearing to interact with a membrane. Another instrument is visible on the left. There is a small area of dark, charred tissue on the right side.
A close-up laparoscopic view showing a metallic surgical instrument with a black shaft and a visible 'KA' logo, positioned against a background of dark red, glistening tissue.

A laparoscopic view showing pinkish tissue in the background, a large dark instrument entering from the top left, and a distinct area of blackened, charred tissue on the right side. There is a hazy, smoky appearance in the center of the frame.

A close-up view of a laparoscopic surgical instrument, labeled 'KARL STORZ', positioned within a body cavity. The background consists of dark red, vascular tissue. The instrument is metallic and cylindrical, with a tip that appears to be interacting with the tissue on the left.

A laparoscopic view showing a surgical instrument with a hook-like tip interacting with pinkish tissue. Yellowish fatty tissue is visible in the lower center. The background consists of pinkish tissue walls. The image is somewhat hazy, possibly due to smoke or fluid.
A close-up, blurry view of a surgical instrument with a serrated edge moving through pinkish tissue, with a yellowish structure visible in the lower right.

A laparoscopic view shows a black surgical instrument with a blue shaft and a hooked tip entering from the top. It is interacting with a yellowish, fatty tissue structure enclosed by a membrane. The surrounding background tissue is pinkish. There are dark, charred areas on the tissue surface to the right of the instrument tip.

A close-up laparoscopic view showing a metallic surgical instrument with a jaw-like tip entering from the top right. Below it, there is pinkish tissue, some dark coagulated blood or fluid, and a thin white suture thread visible. The background is dark and reddish-brown.

A laparoscopic view shows a large, smooth, pinkish-red organ or tissue mass in the center. A black, elongated surgical instrument with a curved tip is positioned on the surface of the tissue. In the upper left corner, there is a patch of yellowish tissue. The background is dark and out of focus.

A blurry, hazy laparoscopic view showing pinkish tissue in the lower half and a yellowish, fatty-looking structure on the left. A white, linear instrument is visible in the upper right, and the scene is obscured by smoke or vapor.

A blurry, low-contrast laparoscopic view showing a circular field of view. The background is a hazy, pale pinkish-grey tissue. A bright, reflective instrument shaft is visible in the lower center, pointing upwards. The image is obscured by what appears to be smoke or fog, making specific anatomical details like fat pads or membranes indistinct.
Laparoscopic view of a surgical field with pinkish tissue, yellowish fat, and a membrane. A surgical instrument is seen manipulating and dissecting the tissue, with smoke visible in the area.

Laparoscopic view of the abdominal cavity showing yellowish fat pads on a membrane-covered structure, with a black instrument manipulating the tissue. The camera moves, and a different area with pinkish tissue and a second instrument is shown.

Laparoscopic view of the abdominal cavity showing pinkish tissue, yellowish fat pads, and a membrane. A surgical instrument (Karl Storz) is used to manipulate and cut tissue. The scene includes blood, smoke, and various anatomical structures.

A laparoscopic view of a surgical procedure inside a body cavity. A black instrument with a hook at its tip is seen manipulating and cutting through a thin, translucent membrane covering yellowish fatty tissue. A second instrument is also present. The background shows pinkish tissue walls. The action involves the hooked instrument piercing and dissecting the membrane from bottom to top.

A laparoscopic view of a surgical cavity showing pinkish tissue walls and yellowish fat deposits. A dark, elongated instrument is seen manipulating and cutting through a membrane-covered structure, with smoke visible. A white, perforated instrument enters the frame near the end of the clip.

Laparoscopic view of a surgical procedure inside the body. A long, dark instrument labeled 'KARL STORZ' is visible on the left. A second, thinner instrument with a hook-like tip is seen manipulating and cutting through a membrane covering a fatty, elongated tissue structure. Smoke is present throughout the scene. The background shows pinkish tissue and yellowish fat deposits.

Laparoscopic view of a surgical cavity with pinkish tissue walls and yellowish fat deposits. A black instrument with a blue tip is seen interacting with a membrane-covered structure, causing smoke and revealing charred, yellowish tissue. A second metallic instrument enters the frame later to assist.
